blockers.description: 2022-05-13 date collision unresolved. 'Day 23 Solomons Island' (Deltaville→Solomons, matches Nebo log dated 2022-05-13 exactly, 54.8nm) currently sits at 2022-05-13, but 'Days 16-22 Nor'easter in Deltaville' (storm-bound week, no real travel) is ALSO dated 2022-05-13 and needs to move earlier (proposed 2022-05-07, unconfirmed). The original Blogger post for 'Day 23' is published 2022-05-14 (fetched live), which caused a false lead: moving Day 23 to 05-14 would have been WRONG because the existing 2022-05-14 Nebo map is a different, already-correctly-matched trip (Solomons→Severna Park, matching 'Day 24 Fog Leaving Solomons'). No file was changed for this — investigated only.
blockers.workaround: Next session: keep 'Day 23' at 2022-05-13 (map already correct there), move 'Days 16-22 Nor'easter in Deltaville' to an earlier date (~2022-05-07, the day after Day 15's 05-06 arrival) with 0 miles/hours and no Nebo map, since no Nebo log exists 05-07 through 05-12 (consistent with being storm-bound). This was proposed to the user but not yet confirmed or applied.

decisions.decision: Original Blogger post publish date is a useful cross-check but NOT authoritative for event date — it can lag the real event by 1+ days, same as the frontmatter date issue found all session. Nebo map VISUAL CONTENT (start/end points, place names read directly off the map image) is the most reliable signal, cross-checked against post narrative text.
decisions.rationale: Discovered via the Day 23/24 Solomons Island investigation: blog publish date (05-14) differed from real event date (05-13) for Day 23, while the Nebo map's own visual content unambiguously matched the narrative.

decisions.decision: narrative-viewer.mjs's Gallery-array reorder is safe to automate (flat array, no interleaved prose); reordering inline markdown images in legacy/migrated post bodies is NOT automated — too risky, left for manual editing.
decisions.rationale: Migrated posts interleave prose between images; a Gallery array does not.

decisions.decision: Existing 'Day N' / 'Days N-M' labels in post titles are preserved verbatim, never recomputed from calendar-days-since-voyage-start — the blogger's own count doesn't cleanly match calendar arithmetic (verified: off by several days on a spot check) and recomputing would create inconsistency with the hundreds of untouched posts around each fix.
decisions.rationale: Would create narrative discontinuity across adjacent posts.

next_action: Resolve the 2022-05-13 collision per the workaround above (move 'Days 16-22 Nor'easter in Deltaville' to ~2022-05-07, zero its mileage, no map), get user confirmation, then resume the sequential post-by-post walkthrough starting at 2022-05-13/05-14, using: (1) post text, (2) real photo GPS/date via scripts/lib/photo-chronology.mjs, (3) Nebo map VISUAL content (view the actual image, read place names/start-end points), (4) original Blogger publish date as a secondary cross-check only.
context_notes: This was a very long single session covering two major phases: (1) built substantial new tooling (photo-chronology.mjs, geocode.mjs, three new scripts, narrative-viewer.mjs extensions) to systematically detect and fix date/location/dayType errors across ~72 live migrated blog posts, finding and fixing a real site-wide timezone display bug along the way; (2) pivoted to a slower, more reliable sequential human-in-the-loop walkthrough of the original blog from post 1, after repeated automation false-positives (bogus cross-country origin assignment, state-level geocode false match, waterway-name false positive, (0,0) null-island centroid bug) taught that full automation isn't safe here. The user's core insight this session: the ORIGINAL Blogger posts each end with a Nebo map screenshot Barbara made herself from her phone — meaning ground truth may already exist in the original blog content, not something that needs reconstructing. This was not yet exploited before context ran out. Nothing is broken; build passes; all changes are uncommitted in the working tree.
